observations: Two solar panels are stacked on a metal trolley or stand.
The panels have silver aluminum frames.
The solar cells are dark blue/black, characteristic of monocrystalline or half-cut cell technology.
A watermark 'NAGOTECH SOLAR' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across the center.
No manufacturer labels, brand logos, or technical specification stickers are visible in the photo.

claims.evidence: The technical specification sticker on the back is not shown.
No Jinko logo or branding is visible on the frame or cells in photo 0.
Requires a clear shot of the full panel to count or a spec sheet to verify.

risks.risk: The panel may be a lower wattage or a generic brand rather than Jinko 600W.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's specification label on the rear of the panel.

risks.risk: The panel may be electrically faulty or have significantly degraded output.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter reading of the Open Circuit Voltage (Voc) in direct sunlight.

risks.risk: Hidden damage to the backsheet or junction box.
risks.proof: A photo of the entire underside/back of the panel.

proof_requests: Photo of the technical specification sticker on the back of the panel.
Photo of the junction box and output cables.
Video of a multimeter test showing the voltage output in daylight.
Clear photo of the entire back of the panel to check for burns or scratches.
response.reason: The brand and wattage are the primary drivers of value for solar panels and cannot be verified without a photo of the manufacturer's specification label.
